common.buttons.save.context: Generic Save button label. Byte-identical string repeats at base-layout.html:2009,2084,2182,2320,2599 and static/js/app-core.js:4382 (profile save) — one shared key is intended to cover all of these call sites.

common.buttons.cancel.context: Generic Cancel button label, repeats at base-layout.html:2007,2082,2180,2318,2597 and as showConfirm() cancelText default at static/js/app-core.js:978.

common.buttons.close.context: Generic close button aria-label/text for modals. Repeats at static/js/app-core.js:942,3517,3533 and base-layout.html:890,903,921,2733.

common.buttons.delete.context: Generic delete button/aria-label, and showConfirm confirmText for delete-type dialogs. Repeats widely (article delete, news delete, category delete, message delete, quiz question/answer row delete).

common.buttons.edit.context: Generic edit button/icon label inside the article modal admin toolbar; same word reused standalone for 'article edit' title tooltips (app-core.js:3286) and table row edit icons (static/js/app-renderers.js:1345 aria-label).

common.buttons.view_all.context: "View all" link under notification/message popovers and dashboard widget footers. Repeats at base-layout.html:448,695,726.

common.buttons.export.context: Generic export button label/icon text, also used for audit-log CSV export button (base-layout.html:2380).

common.buttons.confirm.context: Default confirmText for the shared showConfirm() dialog helper; reused verbatim by several call sites that don't override it (e.g. user status toggle at app-core.js:4412, article status change at app-core.js:4739).

common.buttons.copy.context: Generic 'copy' button/label used for copy-to-clipboard actions (article body copy, code-block copy). Repeats at app-core.js:2990,3348,4151.

common.buttons.back.context: Back-navigation link in the category detail view header ('← უკან'). A longer variant 'უკან დაბრუნება' (Back to portal) exists separately at base-layout.html:848 and article.html:133 — kept as its own key, see articles.json / auth.json.

common.buttons.load_more.context: 'Load more' button appended to the dashboard mandatory-reading/news list when more items exist.

common.status.loading.context: Generic loading placeholder text, used as the initial textContent for many async-populated elements (profile fields, dropdowns, modals, popovers). This exact string (with 3 trailing dots) recurs dozens of times across base-layout.html, static/js/app-core.js, static/js/app-renderers.js, static/js/dept-dashboard.js and static/js/audit-dashboard.js — only one representative source is cited.

common.status.loading_ellipsis.context: Same meaning as common.status.loading but uses a single Unicode ellipsis character (…) instead of three periods — kept separate because the bytes differ. Also appears at static/js/audit-dashboard.js:324 and base-layout.html:1215,1233.

common.toast.error_title.context: Default toast title when variant === 'error' in the shared showToast() helper; also used standalone as a toast title in many call sites (e.g. static/js/app-router.js:19,70).

common.toast.success_title.context: Default toast title when variant === 'success'; also used standalone as a toast title (e.g. static/js/app-core.js:1731,3439,6229).

common.toast.warning_title.context: Default toast title when variant === 'warning' in showToast().

common.toast.default_title.context: Fallback toast title when no variant matches (default case) in showToast().

common.session.expired.ka: სესია ამოიწურა — გთხოვთ ხელახლა შეხვიდეთ სისტემაში.
common.session.expired.en: Your session has expired — please log in again.
common.session.expired.context: Alert shown when a stored auth token is detected as expired/invalid.

common.filters.all.context: Generic 'All' filter/tab/dropdown option, reused as the default option text for department, role, category and status filters across the app (e.g. base-layout.html:944,1085,1727,1734,1812,2101,2148,2296 'All' value option). Ambiguous: the same bare word is used for several different filter axes (all departments, all roles, all statuses, all time) — a human should decide whether these need distinct translation keys per axis or can share one.

common.departments.tech.context: Department name/dropdown option 'Technical' (call-center technical support dept). Repeats verbatim as an <option> value+label at base-layout.html:1086,1728,1943,2062,2149 and as a display badge in static/js/app-renderers.js:462, static/js/app-core.js:505/1764/1919.

common.departments.info.context: Department name/dropdown option, short form of 'Informational' department. Repeats at base-layout.html:1087,1729,1944,2063,2150 and static/js/app-core.js:504/1763/1917.

common.departments.office.context: Department name/dropdown option 'Office'. Repeats at base-layout.html:1088,1730,1944(area),2064,2151 and static/js/app-core.js:506/1765/1921.

common.departments.all_departments.context: Explicit 'All departments' dropdown option/badge text (distinct from the bare common.filters.all). Repeats at base-layout.html:1637 and static/js/app-core.js:2131/3868 ('ყველა დეპარტამენტი' shown when target_department === 'All').

common.roles.operator.context: Role name / dropdown option. Repeats at base-layout.html:1735,2164,2226 and displayed in static/js/app-core.js:1095 (profile role badge fallback).

common.roles.manager.context: Role name / dropdown option. Repeats at base-layout.html:1736,2165,2228 and static/js/app-core.js:1095.

common.roles.content_admin.context: Role name / dropdown option for content_admin role. Repeats at base-layout.html:2166,2228.

common.roles.system_admin.context: Role name / dropdown option for admin role. Repeats at base-layout.html:2167,2229. Note: security.py:159 stores a differently-worded 'სისტემური ადმინი' for a seeded test account display name — flagged as a probable near-duplicate for human review, see README.

common.action_labels.action.context: Generic 'Action' table column header, repeats across nearly every admin table in base-layout.html (e.g. 1841,1863,1882,2119,2245,2333).

common.table.name_column.context: Generic 'Name' table column header, reused across the leaderboard, group-users modal, role console and user management tables (base-layout.html:1309,2114,2242,2330; static/js/audit-dashboard.js implicit via dept-dashboard.js:371).

common.table.department_column.context: Generic 'Department' table column header/label, reused very widely (base-layout.html:1283,1707,1861,2116,2244; static/js/dept-dashboard.js:371; static/js/app-core.js:2938).

common.table.email_column.context: 'Email' table column header, repeats at base-layout.html:2243.

common.errors.data_load_failed.context: Generic table-body error row shown across several admin tables/panels (with or without a trailing period in different call sites) when a data fetch fails. Repeats at static/js/app-core.js:6484, static/js/dept-dashboard.js:378/382/397, static/js/audit-dashboard.js implicitly, and static/js/app-renderers.js host errors.

common.errors.no_data_found.context: Generic empty-state table row, repeats at static/js/app-core.js:6917.
